name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audit any website for AI discoverability and on-site engagement barriers. Returns a structured JSON report with findings, recommendations, and an AI readiness score.

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Master entrypoint. Accepts a URL, orchestrates all skills, and returns the final audit report.

skills.name: site-crawler
skills.description: Shared crawl engine. Produces snapshot.json consumed by all audit skills. Not an audit skill itself.

skills.name: crawlability-render-audit
skills.description: Audits whether crawlers can access and read the site: robots.txt, noindex, redirects, JS-only content, broken links.

skills.name: structured-data-content-audit
skills.description: Audits JSON-LD structured data quality and content extractability for AI agents.

skills.name: entity-identity-audit
skills.description: Audits brand name consistency, About/Contact presence, author attribution, and entity disambiguation.

skills.name: freshness-corroboration-audit
skills.description: Audits content currency via date signals and detects internally contradicting facts.

skills.name: engagement-audit
skills.description: Audits visitor orientation, navigation clarity, CTA presence, and dead-end pages.

skills.name: proactive-opportunities-audit
skills.description: Runs last. Suggests improvements beyond defects: FAQ content, BreadcrumbList, Event schema, etc.
